correctness.rationale: The entire 2n-dimensional noisy density matrix follows from a Hamming-distance calculation; all remaining basis states have zero support and J_z does not couple to them. Commuting two-by-two uniform and orthogonal blocks yield the SLD formula for 0<p<1; endpoints follow by continuity. The explicitly differentiated QFI ratio is strictly decreasing for 0<z<=1 since its controlling quadratic has negative derivative and negative value. Opposite endpoint limits give a unique critical root; the uniform-for-fixed-x ratio expansion and bracketing yield n p_c -> 1/2. Independent numerical eigenvalue tests at 100 physical cases and 107 further algebraic/asymptotic checks passed. Numerical tests alone cannot prove all n.

value.rationale: The 2026 motivating work explicitly compares phase-damped W-superposition and GHZ but offers selected-size numerical plots without an analytic crossing law. A physically fixed sensing axis is a meaningful constraint; the result gives an exact, unique noise threshold for the choice between two natural probes, plus the nontrivial n p_c ->1/2 boundary showing that their competition occurs when useful Heisenberg-scale QFI survives. It is not a mere reparameterization of a known table or a one-size computation; the result includes all n>=3, a strict global crossing statement and its sharp asymptotic.
